text: The seven sixty-seven hits the runway. The nose collapses and scrapes along the concrete, slowing it down. The main wheels straddle a guardrail down the middle of the runway, and the jet grinds to a stop, short of the people at the race. A small fire at the nose is put out by racers with hand extinguishers. All sixty-nine people survive. Ten have minor injuries, mostly from the evacuation slides.
